description: This file defines a controller class for an OpenCart module named 'Account'. It handles rendering the module's configuration page and saving its settings within the admin interface.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Account' module configuration in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the account module configuration page with current settings and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save the module's configuration settings, with permission checks and JSON response.
